name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-alcazar-castle-tower
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Alcazar Castle (Tower)
description:
The background seen in one of the towers of Argazarl Castle, from the Super Famicom port of Popful Mail. A good fit for castles or sewers, in general. Uses less than 20 tiles, which makes it great to be used with a lot of decorations.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
